```{r load_libraries, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE}
library(data.table)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggpointdensity)
library(ggpubr)
library(tidyr)
library(stringr)
library(ggrepel)
library(biomaRt)
library(Biostrings)
library(GenomicRanges)
library(dplyr)

theme_set(theme_classic())

data_dir   = "~/research/data/TCR/TCGA"
result_dir = "~/research/data/TCR/TCGA/_results"

output_len = 17
if(output_len %%2 == 0){
  stop("peptide length should be an odd number\n")
}
```

# Read in data


## Read in all the somatic mutation data

```{r}
mutation_file = "mc3.v0.2.8.CONTROLLED.maf.gz"

mut_dat0 = fread(file.path(data_dir, mutation_file), 
                select = c("Hugo_Symbol", "NCBI_Build", "Chromosome", "Strand", 
                           "Start_Position", "End_Position", "Reference_Allele", 
                           "Tumor_Seq_Allele1", "Tumor_Seq_Allele2", 
                           "Variant_Classification", "Variant_Type", 
                           "Feature", "Feature_type", "Consequence", 
                           "HGVSc", "HGVSp_Short", "Transcript_ID"))
dim(mut_dat0)
mut_dat0[1:2,]

table(mut_dat0$Strand)
table(mut_dat0$Variant_Type)
```

## Load somatic mutations and peptide data

Check the format of each type of mutations.Remove three small groups "Nonstop_Mutation", "Splice_Site", and "Translation_Start_Site". Remove entries with "X" in amino acid sequence.

```{r}
mut_data = fread(file.path(result_dir, "step7_mutations.tsv"))
peptides = fread(file.path(result_dir, "step7_peptide_seq.tsv"))

dim(mut_data)
dim(peptides)

mut_data[1:2,]
peptides[1:2,1:3]
substr(peptides$peptide[1:2], 1, 10)
substr(peptides$coding[1:2], 1, 30)
translate(DNAStringSet(substr(peptides$coding[1:2], 1, 30)))

wX = grep("X", peptides$peptide)
wX
peptides$peptide[wX]
peptides = peptides[-wX,]

table(mut_data$Variant_Classification, mut_data$Variant_Type)

class2rm = c("Nonstop_Mutation", "Splice_Site", "Translation_Start_Site")
mut_data = mut_data[-which(mut_data$Variant_Classification %in% class2rm),]
dim(mut_data)
```

## Check the consistency between peptide and coding sequence. 

Remove a few entries where peptides and coding sequences are inconsistent.

```{r warning = FALSE}
pep_len = nchar(peptides$peptide)
coding_len = nchar(peptides$coding)

table(coding_len - pep_len*3)

w2check = NULL

for(i in 1:nrow(peptides)){
  pep_i <- tryCatch({
      translate(DNAString(peptides$coding[i]))
  }, warning = function(w) {
      cat("i:", i, "Warning:", w$message, ". ")
      cat(sprintf("lenght of peptide/coding = %d/%d.\n", 
                  nchar(peptides$peptide[i]), 
                  nchar(peptides$coding[i])))
      translate(DNAString(peptides$coding[i]))
  }, error = function(e) {
      cat("i:", i, "Error occurred:", e$message, "\n")
      NA
  })
  
  if(is.na(pep_i[1])){ next }
  
  if(! as.character(pep_i) == peptides$peptide[i]){
    w2check = c(w2check, i)
  }
}

w2check
translate(DNAString(peptides$coding[w2check[2]]))
AAString(peptides$peptide[w2check[2]])

peptides = peptides[-w2check,]
dim(peptides)
```

## Check the size of reference and alternative alleles.

Filter out mutations without peptide data or has very long reference allele

```{r}
table(mut_data$Transcript_ID %in% peptides$transcript)
mut_data = mut_data[mut_data$Transcript_ID %in% peptides$transcript,]

dim(mut_data)
mut_data[1:2,]

nchar_A1 = nchar(mut_data$Tumor_Seq_Allele1)
nchar_A2 = nchar(mut_data$Tumor_Seq_Allele2)

table(nchar_A1)
table(nchar_A2)

table(mut_data$HGVSp_Short == ".", mut_data$HGVSc == ".")
table(mut_data$HGVSp_Short == ".", nchar_A1 > 10000)

mut_data = mut_data[which(nchar_A1 <= 10000),]
dim(mut_data)
mut_data[1:2,]

table(mut_data$Variant_Classification, mut_data$Variant_Type)
nchar_A1 = nchar(mut_data$Tumor_Seq_Allele1)
tapply(nchar_A1, mut_data$Variant_Classification, table)
```

## Double check Frame_Shift_Del

Remove a few entries whose HGVSp_Short pattern do not match with the general pattern. 

```{r}
ww1 = which(mut_data$Variant_Classification == "Frame_Shift_Del")
table(mut_data$Tumor_Seq_Allele1[ww1])
table(mut_data$Tumor_Seq_Allele2[ww1])

DNA_ref = str_extract(mut_data$HGVSc[i], "(?<=c\\.[\\d|_]{1,20}del)[A|C|G|T]+")
AA_pos  = str_extract(mut_data$HGVSp_Short[i], "(?<=p\\.[A-Z])\\d+")
AA_ref  = str_extract(mut_data$HGVSp_Short[i], "(?<=p\\.)[A-Z]")
AA_mut  = str_extract(mut_data$HGVSp_Short[i], "(?<=p\\.[A-Z]\\d{1,10})([A-Z]|\\*)")

detected = str_detect(mut_data$HGVSc[ww1], "c\\.[\\d|_]{1,20}del[A|C|G|T]+")
table(detected)

detected = str_detect(mut_data$HGVSp_Short[ww1], "p\\.[A-Z]\\d{1,10}([A-Z]|\\*)")
table(detected)

mut_data[ww1[!detected],]
mut_data = mut_data[-ww1[!detected],]
```


## Double check Frame_Shift_Ins

Remove a few entries whose HGVSp_Short pattern do not match with the general pattern. 

```{r}
ww1 = which(mut_data$Variant_Classification == "Frame_Shift_Ins")
table(mut_data$Tumor_Seq_Allele1[ww1])
table(mut_data$Tumor_Seq_Allele2[ww1])

detected = str_detect(mut_data$HGVSc[ww1], "c\\.[\\d]{1,10}dup[A-Z]")
table(detected)

mut_data[ww1[!detected],]
mut_data = mut_data[-ww1[!detected],]
```

## Double check In_Frame_Del
```{r}
ww1 = which(mut_data$Variant_Classification == "In_Frame_Del")
table(nchar(mut_data$Tumor_Seq_Allele1[ww1]))
table(mut_data$Tumor_Seq_Allele2[ww1])

detected = str_detect(mut_data$HGVSc[ww1], "c\\.[\\d|_]+del[A-Z]+")
table(detected)

detected = str_detect(mut_data$HGVSp_Short[ww1], "p\\.[A-Z|\\d|_]+del")
table(detected)
mut_data$HGVSp_Short[ww1]
```

## Extract peptides around each somatic mutation

Check mutation annotation match with the coding or peptide sequences.

* Missense_Mutation: mutated amino acid is at the center of the peptide. 

* Nonsense_Mutation: since mutation created a stop codon, we cannot "see" the mutated amino acid. In the wild type peptide, the mutation is at the center, while the mutated peptide is the wild type peptide that ends right before the mutated amino acid. 

* Indels: we need to obtain the DNA sequence, add mutation to the DNA sequence, and then translate it to protein sequence. 

```{r warning = FALSE}
summary(nchar(peptides$peptide))
table(nchar(peptides$peptide) >= output_len)

w2rm = which(nchar(peptides$peptide) < output_len)
peptides[w2rm,1:3]
gene2rm = unique(peptides$gene[w2rm])

if(length(gene2rm) > 0){
  mut_data = mut_data[which(! mut_data$Hugo_Symbol %in% gene2rm),]
}

pep_df = data.frame(wildtype = rep(NA, nrow(mut_data)), 
                    mutant = rep(NA, nrow(mut_data)), 
                    mut_pos = rep(NA, nrow(mut_data)))

tapply(1:nrow(mut_data), mut_data$Variant_Classification, function(v){v[1:10]})

for(i in 1:nrow(mut_data)){
  w_transcript = which(peptides$transcript == mut_data$Transcript_ID[i])
  stopifnot(length(w_transcript) == 1)
  AAseq  = peptides$peptide[w_transcript]
  DNAseq = peptides$coding[w_transcript]
  AAseq_len = nchar(AAseq)

  ## ------------------------------------------------------------
  ## Missense_Mutation: format like c.608C>T or p.A203V
  ## ------------------------------------------------------------

  if(mut_data$Variant_Classification[i] == "Missense_Mutation"){
    DNA_pos = str_extract(mut_data$HGVSc[i], "(?<=c\\.)\\d+")
    DNA_ref = str_extract(mut_data$HGVSc[i], "(?<=c\\.\\d{1,10})[A|C|G|T]")
    AA_pos  = str_extract(mut_data$HGVSp_Short[i], "(?<=p\\.[A-Z])\\d+")
    AA_ref  = str_extract(mut_data$HGVSp_Short[i], "(?<=p\\.)[A-Z]")
    AA_mut  = str_extract(mut_data$HGVSp_Short[i], "(?<=p\\.[A-Z]\\d{1,10})[A-Z]")

    AA_pos  = as.numeric(AA_pos)
    DNA_pos = as.numeric(DNA_pos)
    
    if(is.na(AA_pos) || is.na(DNA_pos)){
      stop("NAs in positions.")
    }

    stopifnot(DNA_ref == substr(DNAseq, DNA_pos, DNA_pos))
    stopifnot(AA_ref  == substr(AAseq, AA_pos, AA_pos))
    
    ## since AAseq_len >= output_len, the following two conditions can not 
    ## be true the same time
    
    if(AA_pos - (output_len - 1)/2 < 1){
      AA_start = 1; AA_end = output_len
    } else if(AA_pos + (output_len - 1)/2 > AAseq_len){
      AA_start = AAseq_len - output_len + 1; 
      AA_end = AAseq_len
    } else {
      AA_start = AA_pos - (output_len - 1)/2; 
      AA_end = AA_pos + (output_len - 1)/2
    }

    mut_pos = AA_pos - AA_start + 1
    pep_df$mut_pos[i] = mut_pos
    
    if(AA_end - AA_start +1 != output_len){
      stop(sprintf("cannot find a %d-aa long peptide.", output_len))
    }
    
    pep_df$wildtype[i] = substr(AAseq, AA_start, AA_end)
    pep_df$mutant[i]   = pep_df$wildtype[i]
    str_sub(pep_df$mutant[i], start = mut_pos, end = mut_pos) = AA_mut
  }
  
  ## ------------------------------------------------------------
  ## Nonsense_Mutation, format like c.817G>T or p.E273*
  ## ------------------------------------------------------------

  if(mut_data$Variant_Classification[i] == "Nonsense_Mutation"){
    DNA_pos = str_extract(mut_data$HGVSc[i], "(?<=c\\.)\\d+")
    DNA_ref = str_extract(mut_data$HGVSc[i], "(?<=c\\.\\d{1,10})[A|C|G|T]")
    AA_pos  = str_extract(mut_data$HGVSp_Short[i], "(?<=p\\.[A-Z])\\d+")
    AA_ref  = str_extract(mut_data$HGVSp_Short[i], "(?<=p\\.)[A-Z]")
    AA_mut  = str_extract(mut_data$HGVSp_Short[i], "(?<=p\\.[A-Z]\\d{1,10})\\D+")
    stopifnot(AA_mut == "*")
    
    AA_pos  = as.numeric(AA_pos)
    DNA_pos = as.numeric(DNA_pos)
    
    if(is.na(AA_pos) || is.na(DNA_pos)){
      stop("NAs in positions.")
    }

    stopifnot(DNA_ref == substr(DNAseq, DNA_pos, DNA_pos))
    stopifnot(AA_ref  == substr(AAseq, AA_pos, AA_pos))

    ## since AAseq_len >= output_len, the following two conditions can not 
    ## be true the same time
    
    if(AA_pos - (output_len - 1)/2 < 1){
      AA_start = 1; AA_end = output_len
    } else if(AA_pos + (output_len - 1)/2 > AAseq_len){
      AA_start = AAseq_len - output_len + 1; 
      AA_end = AAseq_len
    } else {
      AA_start = AA_pos - (output_len - 1)/2; 
      AA_end = AA_pos + (output_len - 1)/2
    }
    
    # set the position of mutated peptide. it does not matter if it is 
    # at the end of the peptide
    if(AA_pos <= output_len + 1){
      AA_start_mut = 1; AA_end_mut = AA_pos - 1
    } else{
      AA_start_mut = AA_pos - output_len; 
      AA_end_mut = AA_pos - 1
    }

    pep_df$mut_pos[i] = AA_pos - AA_start_mut + 1

    pep_df$wildtype[i] = substr(AAseq, AA_start, AA_end)
    pep_df$mutant[i]   = substr(AAseq, AA_start_mut, AA_end_mut)
  }
  
  ## ------------------------------------------------------------
  ## Frame_Shift_Del
  ## c.472delA or c.1413_1414delTC or p.L306Yfs*7
  ## p.R158Gfs*6 or p.L56*
  ## ------------------------------------------------------------

  # which(mut_data$Variant_Classification == "Frame_Shift_Del" & 
  # nchar(mut_data$Reference_Allele)==4)
  # i = 38
  if(mut_data$Variant_Classification[i] == "Frame_Shift_Del"){
    DNA_pos = str_extract(mut_data$HGVSc[i], "(?<=c\\.)[\\d|_]+")
    DNA_ref = str_extract(mut_data$HGVSc[i], "(?<=c\\.[\\d|_]{1,20}del)[A|C|G|T]+")
    AA_pos  = str_extract(mut_data$HGVSp_Short[i], "(?<=p\\.[A-Z])\\d+")
    AA_ref  = str_extract(mut_data$HGVSp_Short[i], "(?<=p\\.)[A-Z]")
    AA_mut  = str_extract(mut_data$HGVSp_Short[i], "(?<=p\\.[A-Z]\\d{1,10})([A-Z]|\\*)")
    
    # p.N1671Ifs*4  corresponds to mutated peptide of IVL*
    # so 4 means 4 aa including the mutated one and the stop codon.

    if(AA_mut == "*"){
      AA_mut_len2stop = "1"
    }else{
      AA_mut_len2stop  = str_extract(mut_data$HGVSp_Short[i], "(?<=fs\\*)\\d+")
    }
    AA_mut_len2stop = as.numeric(AA_mut_len2stop) - 1

    AA_pos  = as.numeric(AA_pos)
    DNA_pos = as.numeric(unlist(strsplit(DNA_pos, split="_")))
    
    if(is.na(AA_pos) || is.na(DNA_pos[1])){
      stop("NAs in positions.")
    }

    stopifnot(DNA_ref == substr(DNAseq, DNA_pos[1], DNA_pos[length(DNA_pos)]))
    stopifnot(AA_ref  == substr(AAseq, AA_pos, AA_pos))

    ## translate the coding DNA sequence
    DNAseq_mut = paste0(substr(DNAseq, 1, DNA_pos[1]-1), 
                        substring(DNAseq, DNA_pos[length(DNA_pos)] + 1))
    AAseq_mut  = as.character(translate(DNAString(DNAseq_mut)))
    stop_pos   = gregexpr("\\*", AAseq_mut)
    
    if(stop_pos[[1]][1] == -1){
      AA_mut_len2stop = nchar(AAseq_mut) - AA_pos + 1
    }else{
      stopifnot(stop_pos[[1]][1] == AA_pos + AA_mut_len2stop)
    }
    
    stopifnot(AA_mut  == substr(AAseq_mut, AA_pos, AA_pos))
    
    # AA_mut_len2stop is the position of stop codon, 
    # so we need to remove it using AA_mut_len2stop - 1

    if(AA_mut_len2stop - 1  < (output_len -1)/2){
      AA_end = AA_pos + AA_mut_len2stop - 1
      AA_start = max(1, AA_end - output_len + 1)
    } else if(AA_pos - (output_len - 1)/2 < 1){
      AA_start = 1; 
      AA_end = output_len
    } else{
      AA_start = AA_pos - (output_len - 1)/2; 
      AA_end = AA_pos + (output_len - 1)/2
    }
    
    pep_df$mut_pos[i] = AA_pos - AA_start + 1

    pep_df$wildtype[i] = substr(AAseq, AA_start, AA_end)
    pep_df$mutant[i]   = substr(AAseq_mut, AA_start, AA_end)
  }
  
  ## ------------------------------------------------------------
  ## Frame_Shift_Ins
  ## c.224dupA or p.N75Kfs*15
  ## ------------------------------------------------------------

  detected = str_detect(mut_data$HGVSc[ww1], "c\\.[\\d]{1,10}dup[A-Z]")

  if(mut_data$Variant_Classification[i] == "Frame_Shift_Ins"){
    DNA_pos = str_extract(mut_data$HGVSc[i], "(?<=c\\.)\\d+")
    DNA_mut = str_extract(mut_data$HGVSc[i], "(?<=c\\.\\d{1,20}dup)[A|C|G|T]+")
    AA_pos  = str_extract(mut_data$HGVSp_Short[i], "(?<=p\\.[A-Z])\\d+")
    AA_ref  = str_extract(mut_data$HGVSp_Short[i], "(?<=p\\.)[A-Z]")
    AA_mut  = str_extract(mut_data$HGVSp_Short[i], "(?<=p\\.[A-Z]\\d{1,10})[A-Z]|\\*")
    
    if(AA_mut == "*"){
      AA_mut_len2stop = "1"
    }else{
      AA_mut_len2stop  = str_extract(mut_data$HGVSp_Short[i], "(?<=fs\\*)\\d+")
    }
    AA_mut_len2stop = as.numeric(AA_mut_len2stop) - 1

    AA_pos  = as.numeric(AA_pos)
    DNA_pos = as.numeric(DNA_pos)
    
    if(is.na(AA_pos) || is.na(DNA_pos)){
      stop("NAs in positions.")
    }
    
    stopifnot(AA_ref  == substr(AAseq, AA_pos, AA_pos))

    ## translate the coding DNA sequence
    DNAseq_mut = paste0(substr(DNAseq, 1, DNA_pos), DNA_mut, 
                        substring(DNAseq, DNA_pos + 1))
    AAseq_mut  = as.character(translate(DNAString(DNAseq_mut)))
    stop_pos   = gregexpr("\\*", AAseq_mut)
    
    if(stop_pos[[1]][1] == -1){
      AA_mut_len2stop = nchar(AAseq_mut) - AA_pos + 1
    }else{
      stopifnot(stop_pos[[1]][1] == AA_pos + AA_mut_len2stop)
    }

    stopifnot(AA_mut  == substr(AAseq_mut, AA_pos, AA_pos))
    
    # AA_mut_len2stop is the position of stop condon, 
    # so we need to remove it using AA_mut_len2stop - 1

    if(AA_mut_len2stop - 1  < (output_len -1)/2){
      AA_end = AA_pos + AA_mut_len2stop - 1
      AA_start = max(1, AA_end - output_len + 1)
    } else if(AA_pos - (output_len - 1)/2 < 1){
      AA_start = 1; AA_end = output_len
    } else{
      AA_start = AA_pos - (output_len - 1)/2; 
      AA_end = AA_pos + (output_len - 1)/2
    }
    
    pep_df$mut_pos[i] = AA_pos - AA_start + 1

    pep_df$wildtype[i] = substr(AAseq, AA_start, AA_end)
    pep_df$mutant[i]   = substr(AAseq_mut, AA_start, AA_end)
  }
  
  ## ------------------------------------------------------------
  ## In_Frame_Del
  ## c.1743_1745delGAA or p.K582del
  ## ------------------------------------------------------------

  if(mut_data$Variant_Classification[i] == "In_Frame_Del"){
    AA_pos1 = str_extract(mut_data$HGVSp_Short[i], "(?<=p\\.[A-Z])\\d+")
    AA_ref1 = str_extract(mut_data$HGVSp_Short[i], "(?<=p\\.)[A-Z]")
    
    if(str_detect(mut_data$HGVSp_Short[i], "_")){
      AA_pos2 = str_extract(mut_data$HGVSp_Short[i], "\\d+(?=del)")
      AA_ref2 = str_extract(mut_data$HGVSp_Short[i], "[A-Z](?=\\d+del)")
    }else{
      AA_pos2 = AA_pos1
      AA_ref2 = AA_ref1
    }

    if(is.na(AA_pos1) || is.na(AA_pos2)){
      stop("NAs in positions.")
    }
    
    AA_pos1 = as.numeric(AA_pos1)
    AA_pos2 = as.numeric(AA_pos2)

    stopifnot(AA_ref1  == substr(AAseq, AA_pos1, AA_pos1))
    stopifnot(AA_ref2  == substr(AAseq, AA_pos2, AA_pos2))

    del_len = AA_pos2 - AA_pos1 + 1
    AAseq_len_mut = AAseq_len - del_len
    
    AAseq_mut = paste0(substr(AAseq, 1, AA_pos1-1), substring(AAseq, AA_pos2+1))
    AA_start_mut = (AA_pos1 - 1) - (output_len - 1)/2 
    AA_end_mut   = (AA_pos1 - 1) + (output_len - 1)/2 

    if(AA_start_mut < 1 ){
      gap = 1 - AA_start_mut
      AA_start_mut = 1
      AA_end_mut = AA_end_mut + gap
    }else if(AA_end_mut > AAseq_len_mut){
      AA_end_mut = AAseq_len_mut
      AA_start_mut = AA_end_mut - output_len + 1
    }
    mut_pos = (AA_pos1 - 1) - AA_start_mut + 1
    pep_df$mut_pos[i] = mut_pos
    
    end_len = (output_len - del_len)/2
    
    ## if the deletion is longer than the desired output_len,
    ## just take the first output_len AAs
    if(end_len > 0){
      AA_start = AA_pos1 - ceiling(end_len) 
      AA_end   = AA_pos2 + floor(end_len)
    }else{
      AA_start = AA_pos1
      AA_end = AA_start + output_len - 1
    }
    
    if(AA_start < 1 ){
      AA_end = AA_end + 1 - AA_start
      AA_start = 1
    }else if(AA_end > AAseq_len){
      AA_start = AA_start - (AA_end - AAseq_len)
      AA_end = AAseq_len
    }

    pep_df$wildtype[i] = substr(AAseq, AA_start, AA_end)
    pep_df$mutant[i]   = substr(AAseq_mut, AA_start_mut, AA_end_mut)
  }  
}
```


# Write out results
```{r}
dim(pep_df)
pep_df[1:2,]

dim(mut_data)

mut_data = cbind(mut_data, pep_df)
fwrite(mut_data, file.path(result_dir, 
                           sprintf("step7c_mutations_peptides_%d.tsv", output_len)))
```
